notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP - curl_cffi impersonate=chrome, no blocks encountered (robots.txt allows /collections/ and /sitemap.xml; no Claude-specific disallow). TREE METHOD: Union of homepage mega-menu top-nav (11 top categories) and each category page's own plp-sub-nav strip, recursing while children represent distinct PRODUCT TYPES; recursion stopped once a node's own children were clearly attribute/filter variants (size e.g. King/Queen/Single, pattern e.g. Floral/Ethnic/Abstract/Solid/Geometric, material e.g. Cotton/Microfiber, or delivery-speed tags like Fast Delivery/Best Seller/Whats New) rather than new product types - those deeper filter pages were not recorded as separate rows. This is a large Shopify-style catalog (sitemap listed 35 product sub-sitemaps and thousands of SEO collection URLs); the mega-menu + subnav union was used as the authoritative category tree instead of the raw collections sitemap, which is dominated by long-tail attribute-combo URLs not true navigation categories. QTY METHOD: exact 'N Products' count from each collection page's own summary header (collection-page-summary-count), never the parent aggregate when subcategories existed (e.g. top-level Bedding=4517, Home Furnishings=5831, Storage & Organisers=2469, Home Decor=47868, Dining Table Decor=6772, Kitchen=1414, Bath Decor=1823, Rugs & Carpet=1716, Kids Room Decor=1175 were all parent aggregates with valid subcategories, recorded only as grouping rows per the parent-URL rule). h1/canonical verified to match the requested slug on every leaf recorded; one mismatch caught and corrected: the Kitchen Linens subnav link labeled 'Table Runners' (slug table-runners) actually renders h1 'Table Covers & Runners' - recorded under its real h1 name. EXCLUDED (checked and rejected, with reason): Bathroom Sets (bathroom-sets, 141) - product photos show Ceramic/Resin/Marble/Polyresin bath accessory sets, not textile; Table Coasters (table-coasters, 526) - dominant materials Wood/Brass/Marble/Ceramic/Glass, not textile; Hot Mats & Pot Holders (hot-mats-pot-holders, 31) - dominant materials Aluminium/Stainless Steel/Wood/MDF (metal/wood trivets, not fabric potholders); Tissue Box/Napkin Rings/Towel Hanger/Curtain Rods - hardware/non-textile accessories per rule; Trinket Trays (jewellery-stand-trinket-trays, 17) - Concrete/Aluminium/Polyresin/Wood/Resin, reads as decorative catch-all tray not genuine jewelry storage (storage.md Sec.23 Decorative Tray exclusion); Shelf Liners (shelf-liners, 3) - Plastic/EVA/Polymer surface protector, not a storage/containment item despite living under the Storage & Organisers nav; Dustbins and Tissue Holder (under Kitchen/Bathroom Organisers) - waste disposal / single-purpose holder, not storage/organization of belongings; Book Ends (desk-organisers) - functional prop, not a container; Hammock and Knob (living-room-organisers) - furniture/hardware, not storage; Bathroom Accessories (bathroom-accessories, reused under Bathroom Organisers) - mixed soap-dispenser/soap-dish/hair-dryer-holder set, not primarily storage; Lunch Boxes and Casseroles & Hot Boxes (under Containers & Jars) - food-carry/cookware items, not home storage; Wall Decor's other children (Wall Art, Wall Accents, Photo Frames, Wall Plates, Vastu, Wall Posters, Wall Mirrors) - non-textile decor, only its Wall Tapestries child qualified as Textile; Gifts, Garden Decor, Cookware, Bottles, Kitchen Tools, Bakeware, Dinner/Plates/Bowls/Cutlery/Barware/Mugs/Trays (Kitchen & Dining), Lamps & Lighting, Showpieces/Vases, Artificial Plants, Pots & Planters, Accent Furnitures, Clocks, Mirrors, Candles - all excluded as out-of-scope categories (Kitchen & Dining / Decorative Accessories / Lighting / Furniture / Garden per rule boundaries). Duplicate URLs seen from two different nav paths were recorded once: Runner Rugs (Home Furnishings and Rugs & Carpets both link /collections/runner-rugs - kept once under Rugs & Carpets); Table Covers, Table Mats & Napkins (Kitchen Linens and Table Linens both link the same URLs - kept once under Table Linens, the more specific/dedicated node); Kitchen Organisers (/collections/organisers is linked from both the Storage & Organisers nav and the Kitchen Decor nav - kept once under Storage & Organisers). Table Runners under Kitchen Linens vs Table Linens use genuinely different URLs (table-runners vs table-runners-1) so both were kept as separate rows. Vaaree matches the strong prior: a substantial home-textile catalog (bedding, curtains, cushions, rugs, bath and table linens) plus a real but much smaller Storage & Organisers vertical.
